WITH SOTMP AS ( SELECT SO.TRADE_ID, SO.SETTLE_DATE, SOE.IS_TRADE FROM STL_ORDERS SO,STL_ORDERS_EXT SOE WHERE SO.ORDER_ID = SOE.ORDER_ID AND SOE.IS_TRADE = 'N' ) SELECT T.FINPROD_TYPE finprodtype, T.PS, SUM(NVL(T.PRIN_AMT,0)*DECODE(T.TRADE_STATUS,'03',-1,1)) prinamt, SUM(NVL(T.INT_AMT,0)*DECODE(T.TRADE_STATUS,'03',-1,1)) intamt, SUM(NVL(T.TRADE_AMT,0)*DECODE(T.TRADE_STATUS,'03',-1,1)) tradeamt FROM ( SELECT DEAL.FINPROD_TYPE, DEAL.PS, NVL(OT.SETTLE_DATE,DEAL.SETTLE_DATE) SETTLE_DATE, DEAL.PRIN_AMT, DEAL.INT_AMT, DEAL.TRADE_AMT, DEAL.TRADE_STATUS FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL DEAL INNER JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING BDA ON BDA.BUSI_NO = DEAL.TRADE_ID
AND BDA.BOOKSET_ID in
#{item}
LEFT JOIN SOTMP OT ON DEAL.TRADE_ID = OT.TRADE_ID ) T WHERE TO_CHAR(T.SETTLE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') >= #{vdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TO_CHAR(T.SETTLE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= #{mdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY T.FINPROD_TYPE,T.PS

WITH SOTMP AS ( SELECT SO.TRADE_ID, SO.SETTLE_DATE, SOE.IS_TRADE FROM STL_ORDERS SO,STL_ORDERS_EXT SOE WHERE SO.ORDER_ID = SOE.ORDER_ID AND SOE.IS_TRADE = 'N' ) SELECT T.BOOKSET_ID booksetId, T.FINPROD_TYPE finprodtype, T.PS, SUM(NVL(T.PRIN_AMT,0)*DECODE(T.TRADE_STATUS,'03',-1,1)) prinamt, SUM(NVL(T.INT_AMT,0)*DECODE(T.TRADE_STATUS,'03',-1,1)) intamt, SUM(NVL(T.TRADE_AMT,0)*DECODE(T.TRADE_STATUS,'03',-1,1)) tradeamt FROM ( SELECT BDA.BOOKSET_ID, DEAL.FINPROD_TYPE FINPROD_TYPE, DEAL.PS, NVL(OT.SETTLE_DATE,DEAL.SETTLE_DATE) SETTLE_DATE, DEAL.PRIN_AMT, DEAL.INT_AMT, DEAL.TRADE_AMT, DEAL.TRADE_STATUS FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL DEAL INNER JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING BDA ON BDA.BUSI_NO = DEAL.TRADE_ID
AND BDA.BOOKSET_ID in
#{item}
LEFT JOIN SOTMP OT ON DEAL.TRADE_ID = OT.TRADE_ID ) T WHERE TO_CHAR(T.SETTLE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') >= #{vdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TO_CHAR(T.SETTLE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= #{mdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY T.BOOKSET_ID,T.FINPROD_TYPE,T.PS
